subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, with prompt-driven selective channel routing split or declined separately?
rationale: The source-confirmed command prompt gap is narrow, but allowing prompts or rules to choose delivery channels would change message-delivery policy and may affect channel/plugin contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle() only.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Track prompt-driven channel-selective replies as a separate product/API design before changing delivery behavior.

options.title: Decline Prompt-Driven Routing
options.body: Keep reply routing host-controlled and close the broader routing request after the metadata gap is handled.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle() only.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest history on the shared command prompt bundle and already provided concrete scope guidance on the issue.
